chunks: Begin with those whom you support.

key_terms.اِبْدَأْ: Start first; give priority in action.
key_terms.تَعُولُ: You support, maintain, and provide for financially.

ai.seo_question: Who should a person begin supporting and caring for first in Islam?
ai.summary: This concise prophetic teaching directs a person to begin care, generosity, and good conduct with those under his support and responsibility. It emphasizes that ethical responsibility starts with one’s dependents and family before extending outward to others.
